name: print-social-lets-work-creativity-stories-purple-flat-illustration-props
title: 'Let's Work / Be Creative' story set on white with flat-illustrated design tool clusters and dashed lines
whatItIs: Four vertical white story cards on a lilac background, each with bold headlines ('Let's Work', 'Be Creative', 'Create with Us', 'Build Your Creativity') above a cluster of flat-illustrated design props (pencils, a laptop, a folder, a target icon, a lightbulb) in coral, purple and cream, with dashed decorative lines.
whatItMeans: Friendly and inviting; clustering recognisable design tools makes an abstract 'creativity' pitch feel grounded in real work.
techniques: Cluster several related props into one illustrated group per card.
Keep a consistent white base across a story set for a clean feel.
Use dashed lines as a light decorative accent.

vocabulary.definition: Several related illustrated objects grouped together.
A broken line used as subtle decoration.
